meta.title: The vendor fills price cells and the total computes
gaps: Validate the total against the template-specific GST rule when GST is included.
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`
can only test part of this — no step for: Validate the total against the template-specific GST rule when GST is included.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Create an RFQ pricing stage for the bid sheet.
Apply a pricing template so the bid sheet is available.
Create one line item with the requested quantity of 10.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor that will enter the bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet as the vendor.
Enter 100 in the vendor price cells without submitting, leaving the computed total visible.
Check that the rendered total includes the expected arithmetic result for quantity 10 multiplied by price 100.
